name: Dr. Khalid's standard for interactive pages
note: Checked automatically where possible. Edit this file (via Claude) when the standard changes.

features.label: Explanation first: rule cards giving the logic (the why)
🔊 buttons with the device's French voice (pronunciation)
« French in your English » etymology section (accurate)
Colour code: stem blue · ending pink tag · auxiliary green tag, with legend
Levels: each level trains one thing
Final mixed « all together » level
Level menu (cards saying what each level teaches + « All levels »)
Level bar always visible above every question
Short levels (about 3–5 items each)
Two steps in every level: ① Choose, then ② Write the same answers
Accent keys é è ê à ç ô î ' for written answers
Typed answers ignore capitals, spaces, punctuation, curly apostrophes; accents count; variants accepted
1st wrong answer → precise hint naming the fault; 2nd → answer shown
← Previous button and clickable dots
Student plays themselves: first name + « un étudiant / une étudiante » used in every line (dialogue pages)
Name field
End summary « Points forts » / « Erreurs à revoir »
Results saved to the master page
French sentences; English instructions and feedback
Very colourful page
No sentences or exercises copied from the book
Yellow highlighter or bright filled blocks (rejected style)
